records.title: Promethazine
records.summary: Standard treatment for space motion sickness in the first 2-3 days of flight since the Shuttle era, usually given by intramuscular injection so it works while the gut is unsettled.

data.spaceflight_note: Standard treatment for space motion sickness in the first 2-3 days of flight since the Shuttle era, usually given by intramuscular injection so it works while the gut is unsettled.
data.cautions: Strong drowsiness. Do not schedule critical tasks or EVA soon after a dose. Can lower blood pressure.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Scopolamine + dextroamphetamine (ScopeDex)
records.summary: Used on early Shuttle flights to prevent motion sickness. The stimulant offsets the sleepiness from scopolamine.

data.spaceflight_note: Used on early Shuttle flights to prevent motion sickness. The stimulant offsets the sleepiness from scopolamine.
data.cautions: Dry mouth, blurred near vision, urinary retention. Stimulant: controlled substance.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Meclizine
records.summary: Milder option for motion sickness and for vestibular symptoms after return to gravity.

data.spaceflight_note: Milder option for motion sickness and for vestibular symptoms after return to gravity.
data.cautions: Drowsiness. Avoid before tasks needing full alertness.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Ondansetron
records.summary: Non-sedating option for nausea. Orally dissolving form does not need water or a working gut.

data.spaceflight_note: Non-sedating option for nausea. Orally dissolving form does not need water or a working gut.
data.cautions: Headache, constipation. Can affect heart rhythm (QT) in high doses.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Zolpidem
records.summary: A study of 85 Shuttle and ISS crew (Barger et al., 2014) found sleep medication used on about half of Shuttle nights; zolpidem and zaleplon were the most common.

data.spaceflight_note: A study of 85 Shuttle and ISS crew (Barger et al., 2014) found sleep medication used on about half of Shuttle nights; zolpidem and zaleplon were the most common.
data.cautions: Next-day grogginess. Allow a full sleep period before any emergency-response duty. Not with alcohol or other sedatives.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Zaleplon
records.summary: Very short action, so it was used when crew had only a few hours left before wake-up.

data.spaceflight_note: Very short action, so it was used when crew had only a few hours left before wake-up.
data.cautions: Do not take unless at least 4 h of sleep remain.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Melatonin
records.summary: Used to help shift the body clock during schedule changes, such as slam shifts for vehicle arrivals.

data.spaceflight_note: Used to help shift the body clock during schedule changes, such as slam shifts for vehicle arrivals.
data.cautions: Mild morning drowsiness in some people. Timing matters more than dose.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Modafinil
records.summary: Carried for operational fatigue when crew must stay alert through an off-nominal event.

data.spaceflight_note: Carried for operational fatigue when crew must stay alert through an off-nominal event.
data.cautions: Can disrupt the next sleep period. Controlled substance.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Ibuprofen
records.summary: Pain relievers are among the most used medicines in flight, often for back pain as the spine lengthens in early weightlessness, and for headaches.

data.spaceflight_note: Pain relievers are among the most used medicines in flight, often for back pain as the spine lengthens in early weightlessness, and for headaches.
data.cautions: Stomach irritation and kidney strain, especially if dehydrated. Avoid with kidney-stone symptoms unless the flight surgeon agrees.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Acetaminophen (paracetamol)
records.summary: First choice for fever and when NSAIDs are not suitable, such as kidney concerns or bleeding risk.

data.spaceflight_note: First choice for fever and when NSAIDs are not suitable, such as kidney concerns or bleeding risk.
data.cautions: Liver toxicity above the daily limit. Check other products for hidden acetaminophen.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Aspirin
records.summary: In the chest-pain protocol, aspirin is chewed early unless contraindicated.

data.spaceflight_note: In the chest-pain protocol, aspirin is chewed early unless contraindicated.
data.cautions: Bleeding risk. Not with other NSAIDs routinely.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Naproxen
records.summary: Longer acting than ibuprofen, so fewer doses for persistent back pain.

data.spaceflight_note: Longer acting than ibuprofen, so fewer doses for persistent back pain.
data.cautions: Same cautions as other NSAIDs: stomach, kidneys, hydration.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Pseudoephedrine
records.summary: Fluids shift toward the head in microgravity, giving a stuffy-nose, puffy-face feeling. Decongestants are commonly used for it.

data.spaceflight_note: Fluids shift toward the head in microgravity, giving a stuffy-nose, puffy-face feeling. Decongestants are commonly used for it.
data.cautions: Raises heart rate and blood pressure; can disturb sleep.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Oxymetazoline nasal spray
records.summary: Local relief from headward fluid shift congestion.

data.spaceflight_note: Local relief from headward fluid shift congestion.
data.cautions: Limit to about 3 days; rebound congestion with longer use.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Loratadine
records.summary: Allergies can be triggered by cabin dust and new materials arriving on cargo vehicles.

data.spaceflight_note: Allergies can be triggered by cabin dust and new materials arriving on cargo vehicles.
data.cautions: Usually well tolerated.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Fexofenadine
records.summary: Alternative non-drowsy antihistamine.

data.spaceflight_note: Alternative non-drowsy antihistamine.
data.cautions: Absorption reduced by fruit juice.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Diphenhydramine
records.summary: Part of the allergic-reaction protocol after epinephrine in severe cases.

data.spaceflight_note: Part of the allergic-reaction protocol after epinephrine in severe cases.
data.cautions: Strong drowsiness and dry mouth; can cause urinary retention, already a risk in early flight.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Epinephrine auto-injector
records.summary: Life-saving first step for severe allergic reaction. No ambulance is coming, so it is given early.

data.spaceflight_note: Life-saving first step for severe allergic reaction. No ambulance is coming, so it is given early.
data.cautions: Fast heartbeat, shaking. Benefits outweigh risks in anaphylaxis.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Prednisone
records.summary: Used after the acute phase of an allergic reaction and for inflammatory conditions.

data.spaceflight_note: Used after the acute phase of an allergic reaction and for inflammatory conditions.
data.cautions: Raises blood sugar, affects sleep and mood, weakens immune response with longer use.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Dexamethasone
records.summary: Potent steroid kept for serious inflammatory emergencies.

data.spaceflight_note: Potent steroid kept for serious inflammatory emergencies.
data.cautions: Same steroid cautions; raises blood sugar.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Albuterol inhaler
records.summary: Cabin irritants, smoke or lunar dust can trigger airway narrowing. Use a spacer so the dose does not float away.

data.spaceflight_note: Cabin irritants, smoke or lunar dust can trigger airway narrowing. Use a spacer so the dose does not float away.
data.cautions: Shaky hands, fast heartbeat.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Ciprofloxacin
records.summary: Broad-coverage antibiotic in most spaceflight medical kits.

data.spaceflight_note: Broad-coverage antibiotic in most spaceflight medical kits.
data.cautions: Tendon injury risk, which matters for crew who exercise heavily. Avoid with antacids at the same time.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Amoxicillin-clavulanate
records.summary: Common choice for dental and sinus infections. Dental problems are a known in-flight risk.
tags: Sinus, ear, dental and skin infections

uses: Sinus, ear, dental and skin infections
data.spaceflight_note: Common choice for dental and sinus infections. Dental problems are a known in-flight risk.
data.cautions: Allergy check before first dose. Diarrhea is common.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Azithromycin
records.summary: Short course is convenient where follow-up is limited.

data.spaceflight_note: Short course is convenient where follow-up is limited.
data.cautions: Can affect heart rhythm (QT).
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Doxycycline
records.summary: Alternative for penicillin-allergic crew.

data.spaceflight_note: Alternative for penicillin-allergic crew.
data.cautions: Take upright with plenty of water; sun sensitivity is irrelevant indoors but stomach upset is common.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole
records.summary: Urinary infection risk rises with incomplete bladder emptying in early flight.

data.spaceflight_note: Urinary infection risk rises with incomplete bladder emptying in early flight.
data.cautions: Drink plenty of fluids; rash or allergy possible.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Nitrofurantoin
records.summary: Targets the bladder with little effect elsewhere.

data.spaceflight_note: Targets the bladder with little effect elsewhere.
data.cautions: Not for kidney infection. Take with food.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Valacyclovir
records.summary: Latent viruses such as varicella-zoster and herpes simplex reactivate more often in spaceflight, linked to stress and immune changes.

data.spaceflight_note: Latent viruses such as varicella-zoster and herpes simplex reactivate more often in spaceflight, linked to stress and immune changes.
data.cautions: Hydrate well; adjust in kidney problems.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Fluconazole
records.summary: Closed habitats can favour fungal growth on skin and surfaces.

data.spaceflight_note: Closed habitats can favour fungal growth on skin and surfaces.
data.cautions: Many drug interactions; check with the flight surgeon.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Clotrimazole cream
records.summary: Skin infections are easy to get with limited washing.

data.spaceflight_note: Skin infections are easy to get with limited washing.
data.cautions: Keep cream from floating: apply in small amounts.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Hydrocortisone cream
records.summary: Skin rashes and irritation are among the most common in-flight medical events.

data.spaceflight_note: Skin rashes and irritation are among the most common in-flight medical events.
data.cautions: Not on infected skin; short courses only.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Mupirocin ointment
records.summary: Small wounds heal more slowly in spaceflight; keep them clean and covered.

data.spaceflight_note: Small wounds heal more slowly in spaceflight; keep them clean and covered.
data.cautions: Short course to limit resistance.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Loperamide
records.summary: Fluid loss from diarrhea is harder to notice and correct in microgravity.

data.spaceflight_note: Fluid loss from diarrhea is harder to notice and correct in microgravity.
data.cautions: Not with fever or bloody stool; those need assessment.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Bisacodyl
records.summary: Constipation is common: low fibre, low fluid and less movement.

data.spaceflight_note: Constipation is common: low fibre, low fluid and less movement.
data.cautions: Cramping. Increase fluids first.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Docusate
records.summary: Gentle option, often used with fluid and fibre changes.

data.spaceflight_note: Gentle option, often used with fluid and fibre changes.
data.cautions: Slow onset (1-3 days).
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Omeprazole
records.summary: Reflux is common: the stomach contents have no gravity holding them down.

data.spaceflight_note: Reflux is common: the stomach contents have no gravity holding them down.
data.cautions: Long-term use may affect calcium absorption and bone, a concern in flight.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Famotidine
records.summary: Shorter-acting alternative to omeprazole.

data.spaceflight_note: Shorter-acting alternative to omeprazole.
data.cautions: Generally well tolerated.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Calcium carbonate antacid
records.summary: Quick relief of heartburn.

data.spaceflight_note: Quick relief of heartburn.
data.cautions: Extra calcium adds to kidney-stone risk, already raised by bone loss.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Potassium citrate
records.summary: Tested on the ISS as a countermeasure: it lowers urine calcium-oxalate supersaturation as bone releases calcium.

data.spaceflight_note: Tested on the ISS as a countermeasure: it lowers urine calcium-oxalate supersaturation as bone releases calcium.
data.cautions: Stomach upset; affects potassium levels. Only under flight surgeon direction.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Alendronate
records.summary: An ISS study (LeBlanc et al., 2013) found alendronate plus heavy resistive exercise largely prevented the usual loss of bone density.

data.spaceflight_note: An ISS study (LeBlanc et al., 2013) found alendronate plus heavy resistive exercise largely prevented the usual loss of bone density.
data.cautions: Take upright with a full glass of water, 30 min before food. Oesophagus irritation.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Vitamin D3
records.summary: No sunlight on skin, so crew take supplements to maintain vitamin D for bone health.

data.spaceflight_note: No sunlight on skin, so crew take supplements to maintain vitamin D for bone health.
data.cautions: Excess can raise calcium.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Tamsulosin
records.summary: Urinary retention can occur in early flight; tamsulosin also relaxes the ureter to help a small stone pass.

data.spaceflight_note: Urinary retention can occur in early flight; tamsulosin also relaxes the ureter to help a small stone pass.
data.cautions: Dizziness on standing, which matters most after landing.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Lidocaine
records.summary: Allows the crew medical officer to close wounds and perform minor procedures.

data.spaceflight_note: Allows the crew medical officer to close wounds and perform minor procedures.
data.cautions: Do not exceed the maximum dose by weight.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Tetracaine eye drops
records.summary: Floating debris makes foreign bodies in the eye one of the most frequent ISS medical events. Numbing allows inspection and flushing.

data.spaceflight_note: Floating debris makes foreign bodies in the eye one of the most frequent ISS medical events. Numbing allows inspection and flushing.
data.cautions: Never give for ongoing use: it slows healing and hides injury.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Fluorescein strips
records.summary: Shows scratches under blue light so the crew can photograph them for the flight surgeon.

data.spaceflight_note: Shows scratches under blue light so the crew can photograph them for the flight surgeon.
data.cautions: Temporary yellow tint.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Artificial tears
records.summary: Cabin air is dry and full of floating particles.

data.spaceflight_note: Cabin air is dry and full of floating particles.
data.cautions: Use preservative-free for frequent use.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Morphine
records.summary: Reserved for severe pain when other options fail.

data.spaceflight_note: Reserved for severe pain when other options fail.
data.cautions: Breathing depression and nausea. Controlled substance; have naloxone available.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Naloxone
records.summary: Kept alongside opioids as a safety measure.

data.spaceflight_note: Kept alongside opioids as a safety measure.
data.cautions: Effects may wear off before the opioid's.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Ketamine
records.summary: Preserves breathing reflexes, which makes it suited to remote medicine with limited monitoring.

data.spaceflight_note: Preserves breathing reflexes, which makes it suited to remote medicine with limited monitoring.
data.cautions: Emergence reactions; controlled substance.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Haloperidol
records.summary: Part of the behavioural emergency kit, since crew cannot be removed from the vehicle.

data.spaceflight_note: Part of the behavioural emergency kit, since crew cannot be removed from the vehicle.
data.cautions: Movement side effects; heart rhythm effects.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Lorazepam
records.summary: For severe anxiety or seizures.

data.spaceflight_note: For severe anxiety or seizures.
data.cautions: Sedation and dependence; controlled substance.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Sertraline
records.summary: Long missions with isolation raise mental-health risk; antidepressants take weeks to work, so decisions are made early with ground psychiatry.

data.spaceflight_note: Long missions with isolation raise mental-health risk; antidepressants take weeks to work, so decisions are made early with ground psychiatry.
data.cautions: Start only with flight surgeon and psychiatric support.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Amiodarone
records.summary: Part of the advanced cardiac life-support kit.

data.spaceflight_note: Part of the advanced cardiac life-support kit.
data.cautions: Low blood pressure; specialist drug.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Atropine
records.summary: Treats dangerous bradycardia.

data.spaceflight_note: Treats dangerous bradycardia.
data.cautions: Fast heartbeat, dry mouth, urinary retention.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.

records.title: Nitroglycerin
records.summary: Used in the chest-pain protocol when blood pressure allows.

data.spaceflight_note: Used in the chest-pain protocol when blood pressure allows.
data.cautions: Can drop blood pressure sharply, especially with headward fluid shift changes.
data.dosing: Dose and frequency: per the crew medical checklist or flight surgeon.
